items.title: 52157_Count Basie oral history interview
items.q: I don't know what -- I don't remember Katie Crippen at all. ... Sure, I remember.

ctx.x: Yeah, but remember that you said that you weren't sure -- it was like Jazz Hounds, but the name of her act was not Jazz Hounds.
I don't know what -- I don't remember Katie Crippen at all.
